name: Publish Monad site projection

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_sha:
        description: Exact Monad main SHA; blank resolves current main
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: monad-publication-dispatch
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-and-dispatch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Resolve requested source SHA
        id: source
        env:
          PUSH_SHA: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.sha || '' }}
          MANUAL_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
        run: |
          requested="${PUSH_SHA:-${MANUAL_SHA:-}}"
          if [ -z "$requested" ]; then
            requested="$(git ls-remote https://github.com/monad-framework/monad.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1)"
          fi
          case "$requested" in
            [0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]) ;;
            *) echo "Invalid source SHA" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "sha=$requested" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check out exact source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require current authoritative main
        id: freshness
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          current="$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
          actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "$actual" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
          if [ "$actual" != "$current" ]; then
            echo "stale=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Ignoring stale publication request $actual; current main is $current" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "stale=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Set up Python
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale == 'false'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: scripts/requirements/publication-validation.txt

      - name: Validate deterministic source export
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale == 'false'
        env:
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          python -m pip install -r scripts/requirements/publication-validation.txt
          python scripts/validate-publication.py
          python scripts/export-site-state.py --root . --ref "$SOURCE_SHA" --output .tmp/publication-export --verify-determinism

      - name: Create destination-scoped GitHub App token
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale == 'false'
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v2
        with:
          app-id: ${{ vars.MONAD_PUBLICATION_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.MONAD_PUBLICATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: monad-framework
          repositories: aic-fumadocs-app

      - name: Dispatch exact source identity
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.source.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          jq -n --arg sha "$SOURCE_SHA" '{event_type:"monad-publication",client_payload:{repository:"monad-framework/monad",sha:$sha,projectionVersion:1}}' |
            gh api --method POST repos/monad-framework/aic-fumadocs-app/dispatches --input -
          echo "Dispatched Monad publication for $SOURCE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
